layers.name: access
layers.title: Parks and protected lands (CPAD units)
layers.attribution: California Protected Areas Database (CPAD 2026a), GreenInfo Network, www.calands.org
layers.caveat: Fee-owned protected lands only (no easements). Access is CPAD's ACCESS_TYP field. Geometry generalized for web display.

layers.name: granted
layers.title: Granted public trust lands (CSLC)
layers.caveat: Incomplete: CSLC notes parcel digitization is partial. No polygon does not mean no grant. Not a legal boundary.

layers.name: school
layers.title: State school lands (CSLC)
layers.attribution: California State Lands Commission, Land Management Division
layers.caveat: School lands only. Sovereign tide and submerged lands are not in this layer. Not a legal boundary.

layers.name: waterlines
layers.title: Ordinary high and low water lines (CSLC administrative maps)
layers.caveat: Only portions of some waterways, each mapped at one point in time. These boundaries move; not a statewide or current line.
